modules.name: SBV Silverbox Voice
modules.description: 303-style acid bass voice: curved saw and shaped square, diode ladder, accent sweep, slide, bass comp and key track.

modules.name: SBS Silverbox Sequencer
modules.description: 303-style acid sequencer with separate pitch and time programming, 64 patterns, 7 tracks, scramble and mutate.

modules.name: SBX Silverbox Extended
modules.description: Expander for SBV with extended 303 mods: VEG decay, accent decay, slide time, soft attack, sweep speed, filter FM, overdrive, muffler.
